notes.text:
5. Internal String Allocation of Ekādeśa (Minor Structural Artefact)
Step: #191
Sūtra involved: 6.1.87 आद्गुणः.
Issue: The internal parts array [["rAme", "prakriti", "rAma"], ["na", "sup", "ina"]] indicates the engine sliced off the 'a' of the base and the 'i' of the suffix, assigning the entire ekādeśa 'e' to the prakṛti base.
Classification: Display/Engine structural artefact. It results in the correct surface string, but programmatically shortcuts the dual-replacement nature of an ekādeśa.
notes.author: me
notes.verdict: Claude 2026-11-16 — REPEAT of the ekādeśa-side point (6.1.102 / 6.1.84 / 6.1.88 notes): ā+i → e lodged wholly on the stem, surface rāmeṇa right; Kāśikā 6.1.85 antādivacca. Recorded in S184. No separate work.
